changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: create or alter function metrics.BuildConditionJson ( @assetVersionUid uniqueidentifier ) returns nvarchar(max) as begin declare @conditions nvarchar(max) select @conditions=( select vc.Uid, vc.MatchType, vc.Position, vc.Threshold, vc.Weight, ( select ci.Uid, ci.ConditionType, ci.Operator, ft.Type, ft.LookupObjectType, ft.LookupObjectID, ft.ID as FieldTypeId, ft.Name as FieldTypeName, it.ID as IntersectTypeId, case when ci.Operator = 9 then case when ft.Type = 'Date' then (select min(try_cast([Value] as date)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) when ft.Type = 'DateTime' then (select min(try_cast([Value] as datetime)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) when ft.Type = 'Decimal' then (select min(try_cast([Value] as decimal)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) when ft.Type = 'Number' then (select min(try_cast([Value] as bigint)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) end else null end as StartRangeValue, case when ci.Operator = 9 then case when ft.Type = 'Date' then (select max(try_cast([Value] as date)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) when ft.Type = 'DateTime' then (select max(try_cast([Value] as datetime)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) when ft.Type = 'Decimal' then (select max(try_cast([Value] as decimal)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) when ft.Type = 'Number' then (select max(try_cast([Value] as bigint)) from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) end else null end as EndRangeValue, case when ci.Operator in (9, 16, 17) then null else (select top 1 [Value] from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid) end as SingleValue, case when ci.Operator in (16, 17) then -- In, NotIn ( select [Value] from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItemValue] where Uid = ci.Uid for json path ) else null end as [Values] from [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] ci left join FieldType ft on ft.ID = ci.ConditionFieldTypeID left join IntersectType it on it.ID = ci.ConditionIntersectTypeID where ci.AssetVersionConditionUid = vc.Uid for json path ) as Items from [metrics].[AssetVersionCondition] vc where vc.AssetVersionUid = @assetVersionUid for json path ) return @conditions end
